summary: Rezolve AI plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing a new partnership with fintech Zilch to embed its agentic commerce infrastructure into Zilch's payments platform, serving nearly 6 million customers. The partnership is operational, with no disclosed transaction size, price, or board recommendation. The filing also reaffirms FY26 revenue guidance of ~$360 million. This is a routine business development disclosure, not a special situation. No deal terms, M&A activity, or corporate event triggering special-situation classification exists.
